results.text: Impact of transdermal buprenorphine patch combined with celecoxib on improving shoulder pain and function of patients with primary adhesive shoulder capsulitis. One of the main purposes of clinical treatment for adhesive shoulder capsulitis is pain relief. However, patients often fail to achieve a satisfactory therapeutic response.
